text: The Patriots face the Raiders on Sunday with a decimated secondary, ruled out for the matchup are starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) and Carlton Davis III (neck), forcing New England to lean on reserve coverage while contending with Kirk Cousins, who's enjoyed one of the league's biggest statistical surprises through four weeks. On the bright side, the injury report offers a silver lining: Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice, suggesting the running back could be available, and the Patriots' edge rusher trio of Dre'Mont Jones, Elijah Ponder, and rookie Gabe Jacas has exceeded expectations early in the season, providing at least one dimension of defensive strength. The Patriots will honor Adam Vinatieri during halftime with a Pro Football Hall of Fame induction ceremony, and the team will sport throwback uniforms for the occasion, adding an extra layer of pageantry to a Sunday that'll test how far depth and resilience can carry a team already thin at corner.
